notes: The joined subject has had no Reflect Attribute Values invocation when a distinct requester asks for HLAreportObjectInstancesReflected. The slice verifies one reliable NULL response and checks the HLAobjectInstanceCounts parameter through the standard interaction callback. It makes no claim about nonzero reflection counts, other MOM reports, transport-specific partitions, or overall conformance.

requirements.statement: The distinct requester uses the standard HLArequestObjectInstancesReflected interaction and HLAfederate parameter to select the joined subject that has received no Reflect Attribute Values callback.
The requester observes and validates the standard reflected-object report interaction, transportation, tag, producer, and parameter map through the ordinary interaction callback.

When the joined subject has no reflected object instances for the relevant transportation type, the standard MIM requires one NULL HLAreportObjectInstancesReflected response whose HLAobjectInstanceCounts value is undefined and whose list representation is empty. The test accepts a zero-length undefined value or decodes a supplied standard variable array and requires zero count records.
